correctness.rationale: Every defining triple product is zero, so the Zinbiel identity and free class-two universal property hold. Projection to V and intersection with V tensor V give a bijection of linear subspaces with triples (W,Z,f). Closure of products is equivalent to W tensor W contained in Z, and two-sided ambient closure to W tensor V plus V tensor W contained in Z. The tensor direct sum for V=W+U gives dimensions r^2 and 2nr-r^2, and the Gaussian binomial times Hom-space factor counts all and only such triples. The independent RREF program exhaustively checks full joint (r,z) histograms for n=1,2 over prime fields of cardinalities 2 and 3, totaling 5,6,2825,56632 ambient spaces. For n=2 it obtains subalgebra/ideal totals 221/77 and 949/229, matching the formulas. The abstract types follow by splitting Z into W tensor W and a zero-product complement; dim S^2=r^2 and dim S distinguish every claimed type. Computation does not certify untested dimensions or extension fields; all-field correctness rests on the explicit proof.

originality.rationale: Actual searches of aliases and direct statement-level comparisons with three full-text primary papers and public records found no result giving the full linear-map parametrization together with both exact joint subalgebra and ideal finite-field enumerators and abstract-isomorphism spectra. Ceballos–Towers give abelian maxima/codimension bounds, Camacho et al. describe free Zinbiel objects and superalgebra classification, while Bauer–Schein offer broader qualitative ideal zeta rationality, not these coefficients. Related public findings concern Lie planes, local-algebra monomiality or relatively free affine Lie algebras and do not imply the Zinbiel ordered-tensor statement. Residual equivalence risk from nonunital truncated associative tensor algebras is acknowledged; search absence is not proof of global novelty.
residual_risks: A classical general Grassmannian classification for a truncated nonunital associative tensor algebra with identical triple-zero multiplication may subsume the graph and Gaussian counting formulas under other terminology.

Some general nilpotent-algebra ideal-zeta formula or square-zero extension theorem may imply the coefficients after an unrecorded specialization; the inspected Bauer–Schein theorems alone do not state them.
Results indexed under other names for Zinbiel algebras, including precommutative and chronological algebras, may not be represented among inspected sources.

value.rationale: The free class-two Zinbiel algebra is a canonical all-rank object in a central nonassociative class. Complete classification of all subalgebras and two-sided ideals—including exact embedded finite-field joint spectra and complete abstract isomorphism types—is a natural but nontrivial lattice invariant beyond previously tabulated maximal abelian dimensions. It exposes precise geometric Grassmannian strata and the difference between generating a subalgebra via W tensor W and an ideal via both W tensor V and V tensor W. The result is a structurally motivated all-parameter classification rather than an arbitrary small-case census; it makes no unsupported downstream promises.
